_note: Read by bin/founder-mode at each launch. A group set to off goes into the role's --disallowed-tools, which keeps its definitions out of every request; a role without a row, or a group its row leaves out, takes the default row. Members and the coordinator only: advisors and the isolated role have fixed tool lists. Before you switch a group off, count its uses per role over 14 days. plugins maps a plugin (name@marketplace) to the roles that load it; every other role gets it disabled.
